## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline  
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size = 16 months (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18), selection method = all trading days in OPRA cache, overfit risk = mitigated by walk-forward and out-of-sample validation  
3. **Out-of-sample:** OOS Sharpe = 4.340 (walk-forward 16-month OOS, consistent across STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND and other validated candidates)  
4. **Real-fills:** Real-fills A/B on top 3 J anchor days shows all 3 PUT winners kept, 2 wrong-way CALL losers suppressed (net -$574), edge_capture preserved at 780  
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day observed -$650 (BEARISH_SWEEP_BLOCKER cascade), max drawdown -$2,273, blow-up scenario = consecutive loser days exceeding daily -50% kill switch  
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days contribute ~55% of P&L (based on midday_trendline_gate A/B scorecard); exact figure requires full P&L breakdown
